spark.byteSummary:
Enable dynamic microservices to locate healthy peer instances using client-side or server-side discovery, consensus-backed registries, and TTL heartbeat leases.

Hardcoding IP addresses breaks the moment autoscaling adds pods or a host crashes.

In ephemeral container/cloud environments, IPs change constantly—services register with a consensus-backed registry (etcd/Consul/ZooKeeper) using TTL leases and active health checks.

concept.whyItMatters: Hardcoding IP addresses breaks the moment autoscaling adds pods or a host crashes. [Service Discovery](/concept/microservices-decomposition) pairs a strongly consistent registry with active/passive health checks so callers never route traffic to dead or warming-up instances.
whenToUse: Server-side discovery (Kubernetes Services / ALB / Envoy) for polyglot fleets where clients should stay simple.
Client-side discovery (gRPC name resolver + watch stream) when ultra-low latency or custom load-balancing policies are required.
whenNotToUse: Polling DNS with high TTLs for rapidly autoscaling internal microservices without connection draining.
keyPoints: Client-side discovery: the caller queries the registry (or watches updates), caches healthy endpoints locally, and picks one via Round Robin / Least-Loaded.
Server-side discovery: the caller sends requests to a stable VIP/DNS name; a load balancer or kube-proxy/Envoy routes to healthy registered backends.
Self-registration vs. third-party registration: either the service registers its own TTL lease, or the orchestrator (Kubernetes control plane) updates Endpoints automatically.
Health checks combine liveness (process alive), readiness (dependencies warmed up), and graceful deregistration (preStop hook + drain) to prevent 502s during deploys.

sections.content:
## Architecture & Trade-Off Matrix

| Pattern | Hop Count | Client Complexity | Registry Examples | Best Fit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Client-Side Discovery** | Direct (1 hop) | Higher (SDK per language) | Eureka, Consul SDK, gRPC xDS | Homogeneous high-QPS RPC |
| **Server-Side Discovery** | +1 proxy hop | Zero (standard HTTP/DNS) | Kubernetes Service, AWS ALB, NGINX | Polyglot microservices |
| **Service Mesh (Sidecar)** | Localhost sidecar | Zero app code | Istio/Envoy + Control Plane | mTLS + traffic splitting |
